pages.text: $(l)The Alchemist's Gift$()$(br)Crafted from a book and a gold ingot, worn in an $(l)alchemical accessory slot$().$(br2)$(li)+5% damage dealt.$(li)Below level 10 it gives 1 experience every 2 s.$(li)Right-click to open this book.$(br2)The $(l)Affix Codex$() fills in as you meet affixes.

$(l)Recipe Tree$()$(br)In any inventory, rest the mouse on an item and hold $(l)Ctrl$() for a moment to open its recipe tree: what it is made from and what it makes.$(br2)$(li)Scroll to turn pages$(li)Click an item to open it$(li)Right-click to go back$(li)Grey boxes are alchemy not yet learned
